categories.name: Legendary Trial
categories.rules:
Use IGT for submission time.

Pause Buffering along with Frame Advancing is banned. Any run that uses this will immediately be rejected.

categories.name: IGT
categories.rules: All Individual Challenge submissions must show the full video of the run. It can be a live run, or it can be the recorded personal best in the game.

categories.name: Speedrun Mode
categories.rules:
Must start from a fresh file with no save data. Goal is to complete every challenge in Speedrun Mode. Rank does not matter.

Timing starts when selecting start on Mushzoom in Super Mario Bros.

Timing ends on fadeout after collecting the pin for completing all challenges.

categories.name: Single Game Challenge
categories.rules:
Complete all challenges for a given game, in any order. May be done from a completed file. This does NOT use the in-game timer.

Timing starts when selecting "Start" on the first challenge.

Timing ends when the time pops on the final challenge.

values.rules:
Complete All Speedrun Mode Challenges as fast as possible.

Runs must be done on a new save file.

Timing starts when you select Mushzoom and ends when the credits roll.

values.name: NG+
values.rules:
Complete All Speedrun Mode Challenges as fast as possible.

Runs **must** be done on a complete/incomplete saved file. For new saved files, submit for NG.

Timing starts the frame you select the first challenge and ends the frame you finish the last challenge.
